text:
alex.k: Heads-up — we're rolling an EU firewall tighten at 03:00 UTC (eu-west-1). It's stateful SNI + conntrack limit change. Might drop long-lived ws to inference nodes (GPU warmpool).

maria_p: which pools? will this touch production live traffic?

alex.k: only gpu-warmpool-prod and inference-proxy-asg. Canary to 10% tomorrow morning. No planned downtime but eviction spike possible.

sanjay: are we toggling audit sampling or KMS changes with this? last time audit toggles triggered keystore latency.

alex.k: no KMS changes. We will lower conntrack-max-per-node from 500 -> 50 to reduce memory pressure — that may evict flows. Will add helper to drain long-lived sessions before change.

leo: lowering from 500 to 50 seems aggressive. Any perf numbers? cost/benefit?

alex.k: short convo: current conntrack high memory -> node swap risk; but evictions will cause WebSocket reconnects leading to short lived extra tokens and cost. Tradeoff: prevent node OOM vs increase token churn.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-07T03:00Z -> 10% (gpu-warmpool-prod)

jules: suggest a staged rollout + admission ctrl to favor live inference sessions. Could we pin active sessions to 'sticky-subnet' before change?

emily: we have a runbook snippet — add grace window 10m and increase retry-backoff jitter on client side. snippet:
```:
# k8s pre-drain hook
kubectl annotate pod $POD pre-drain=grace:600
```

sanjay: also need to preserve audit logs. If a conntrack reset hides flows, KMS audit sampling must stay at 100% for 24h. I'll open a short retention override.

maria_p: who owns rollback? @eng-sre oncall?

leo: @eng-sre oncall (sandeep) is on shift — pinged.

sandeep: sandeep: saw the ping. I'll keep an eye on GPU eviction metric: gpu.evict.rate and websocket.reconnect.count. If either spikes >2x baseline for 3m, auto rollback.

alex.k: ack. I'll add the canary and post link to grafana.

alex.k: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/abcd123/gpu-eviction?orgId=1&from=now-1h

maria_p: cost thought — reconnect storms will increase token usage/requests. Estimate +10-20% per affected app. Budget holder: @finance_lead FYI.

ops-bot: incident-bot: created alert "eu-firewall-conntrack-eviction" -> threshold 2x baseline.

alex.k: after canary if metrics stable for 30m, continue 50% at 04:00 UTC, full by 05:00 UTC. If not, rollback to previous conntrack-max-per-node=500.

jules: small ask — include a note in the audit log about the policy change for compliance: 'Firewall policy tighten 03:00 UTC, conntrack limit lowered; keystore unaffected.'

sanjay: opened ticket infra-7362 for audit retention override and compliance note.

maria_p: thanks. I'll publish a short post in #announcements after the full rollout.

alex.k: thanks everyone. will update thread with canary results.
